 --> CAT Admit Card 2026 releasing today @iimcat.ac.in, check download link, steps and exam date
 CAT Admit Card 2026 is scheduled to release today, November 6. Check the latest CAT hall ticket update, official download link, steps, exam date, slots and important instructions. 
 Rajni Pandey 
 November 06, 2026 / 08:38 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 CAT Admit Card 2026 Out Today: Download Link, Date & Exam Details 
 The CAT 2026 admit card is scheduled to be released today, November 6, for candidates appearing in the Common Admission Test (CAT) 2026. The admit card release was earlier scheduled for November 4 but was postponed by the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Indore, which is conducting the examination this year.
 Registered candidates will be able to download their CAT 2026 hall ticket through the official CAT website, iimcat.ac.in, by logging in with their registered User ID and password. The exact release time was not officially confirmed in the latest available update.
 CAT Admit Card 2026: Key Details 
 Particulars Details 
 Exam Common Admission Test (CAT) 2026 
 Conducting institute IIM Indore 
 Admit card release date November 6, 2026 
 CAT exam date November 29, 2026 
 Mode Online 
 Exam sessions Three 
 Official website iimcat.ac.in 
 Login credentials CAT User ID and Password 
 Admit card download Online 
 The admit card download facility is expected to remain available until the examination date, November 29, 2026. Candidates are advised to download the document as soon as it becomes available rather than waiting until the last day.
 Why Was the CAT Admit Card Release Date Changed? 
 The CAT 2026 admit card was initially scheduled to be released on November 4. IIM Indore subsequently revised the schedule and shifted the release date to November 6, 2026. The revised schedule also provides candidates access to the CAT mock test from November 6.
 How to Download CAT Admit Card 2026 
 Candidates can follow these steps to download their CAT 2026 hall ticket:
 Visit the official CAT website at iimcat.ac.in.
 Click on the Registered Candidate Login option.
 Enter your CAT User ID and password.
 Log in to the candidate dashboard.
 Click on the CAT Admit Card 2026 download link.
 Check the details displayed on the admit card.
 Download and save the PDF.
 Take a clear printout for the examination day.
 Candidates should preserve the admit card safely and ensure that the printed copy is clear and readable.
 CAT 2026 Exam Date and Timings 
 The CAT 2026 examination will be conducted on November 29, 2026, in three sessions. The test will be held across approximately 170 cities.
 The reported examination slots are:
 Slot 1: 8:30 AM to 10:30 AM
 Slot 2: 12:30 PM to 2:30 PM
 Slot 3: 4:30 PM to 6:30 PM
 The candidate's exact examination slot, reporting time and centre address will be mentioned on the individual admit card.
 Details Mentioned on CAT Admit Card 
 After downloading the CAT 2026 admit card, candidates should carefully verify the information printed on it. The hall ticket is expected to contain details such as:
 Candidate's name
 CAT registration/application details
 Photograph and signature
 Examination date
 Examination slot
 Reporting time
 Test centre name
 Complete examination centre address
 Important examination-day instructions
 If candidates find any discrepancy in their personal or examination details, they should contact the CAT authorities through the official helpdesk before the examination.
 CAT 2026 Exam Day: What Candidates Must Carry 
 Candidates should carry a printed copy of the CAT 2026 admit card along with the prescribed original photo identity proof to the examination centre. Acceptable identity documents may include Aadhaar, PAN card, passport or voter ID, subject to the examination authority's instructions.
 Candidates should also carefully check the reporting time mentioned on their individual admit card. The examination start time and reporting time are not necessarily the same.
 CAT 2026 Mock Test 
 IIM Indore has also announced that the CAT 2026 mock test will be available from November 6. The mock test is intended to help candidates become familiar with the computer-based test interface and examination format before the actual test.
